rubrics.justification: Uses the provided 3AA grade appropriately and notes image limitations, but it overstates visibility of a distinct ICM and cohesive TE in this low-resolution single plane image; morphology discussion is plausible rather than image-precise.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, stress, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with a sensible prognosis adjustment for BMI; minor issue is conflating implantation and live birth probabilities in one section.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, especially support for single embryo transfer in a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst; slight overemphasis on underweight BMI effects and somewhat loose wording around PGT-A prevent a perfect score.

Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, nutritional optimization, stress management, and follow-up considerations, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
